commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
REPO="MichalMatu/ai-calls"
echo "STAGE=WAIT_FOR_PREVIOUS_VERIFIED_ASSET_PUBLICATION"
READY=false
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  if gh release view v0.2.3 -R "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1; then READY=true; break; fi
  sleep 5
done
test "$READY" = true
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-mvp023-promote-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT
gh release download v0.2.3 -R "$REPO" --pattern "ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk" --pattern "SHA256SUMS.txt" --dir "$OUT"
(cd "$OUT" && shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
SHA="$(shasum -a 256 "$OUT/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
test -s "$OUT/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk"
cat > "$OUT/notes.md" <<EOF
# AI Calls 0.2.3 — First MVP release

**First regular MVP release** for Samsung Galaxy S22+ (SM-S906B), Android 16. This is a functioning on-device AI calling assistant targeting this supported configuration; it is not represented as a universally supported Android dialer.

## What's included
- Fixed main-package Wireless ADB pairing and GSM audio-host startup, replacing broken v0.2.2.
- Guided Phone app role/permissions/SIM setup.
- On-device Gemma model and voice setup, language switching between Polish and English.
- Local conversation history and encrypted notes, optional WAV evidence and explicit manual STOP takeover.

## Install
Download \`ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk\` and \`SHA256SUMS.txt\` from this release. Verify:
\`shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt\` (macOS) or \`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt\` (Linux).
APK SHA-256: \`$SHA\`.

Source commit: \`af7419f24c96d5c011f57bb730f8db6af163f34b\`.
Signing: existing Android Debug certificate, retained for upgrade compatibility with previous MVP builds, **not a dedicated production key**.

## Verification scope and known constraints
Host full test profile, release build and APK signature verified. Physical S22+ testing of Wireless ADB, host setup, model compatibility, language and safe UI has been recorded at predecessor commits; Polish incoming GSM and recording was verified on earlier v0.2.1. An end-to-end incoming real GSM call for this **exact published 0.2.3 APK** has not been separately documented. Complete live GSM and outgoing-call qualification is still device- and scenario-specific. Do not present it as production-qualified across Android devices. Make a rollback copy before upgrading a live dialer.

v0.2.2 has a known GSM setup defect and must not be installed for normal calling. Its historical git tag is preserved for source history.
EOF
echo "STAGE=PROMOTE_RELEASE_TO_STABLE"
gh release edit v0.2.3 -R "$REPO" --title "AI Calls 0.2.3 — First MVP release" --notes-file "$OUT/notes.md" --prerelease=false --latest
DATA="$(gh release view v0.2.3 -R "$REPO" --json tagName,isPrerelease,isLatest,assets)"
echo "$DATA"
echo "$DATA" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; j=json.load(sys.stdin); assert j["tagName"]=="v0.2.3"; assert j["isPrerelease"] is False; assert {a["name"] for a in j["assets"]} >= {"ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk","SHA256SUMS.txt"}'
echo "STABLE_MVP_RELEASE_VERIFIED=true"
echo "STABLE_APK_URL=https://github.com/MichalMatu/ai-calls/releases/download/v0.2.3/ai-calls-v0.2.3.apk"
